about: Mav's 1.5.1.5 set: sell_lvl decides the trader per class (special classes included), a cell h_type written as text is read as its number (other text is a mod error and the cell gets its hashed id), extend adds a class to another mod's class_map cell, and day_gte / day_every without value no longer stop the game (value 1).
expect_mod_errors: quest condition cell_count has no h_type
a condition is not an object

steps.name: gnx_scn_can_sell
steps.why: special class with sell_lvl 0: sold at level 1 (the 1.5.1 rule alone wants level 6)

steps.name: gnx_scn_can_sell
steps.why: sell_lvl -1: never sold, even at level 7

steps.name: gnx_scn_can_sell
steps.why: special class without sell_lvl keeps the level-6 rule

steps.name: gnx_scn_num_id
steps.why: "h_type": "24680" is registered as the number 24680, not as text

steps.name: gnx_scn_cmap_has
steps.why: the extend entry added SELL0 to the other mod's class_map cell

steps.name: scr_gnx_eval_condition
steps.why: day_gte without value: value 1 (it stopped the game before)
